title: Research four-end k8 caller interface map
body:
# Research: map caller obligations for PR #2013's four-end k8 proposal

This package audits the outer-caller boundary of the exact four-end attaining assignment in PR #2013, using the pinned R480 word and the earlier physically admitted two-end recipe as a comparator.

For changed ends 574, 575, 580 and 581, the pinned scalar prefix requires source registers 412, 414, 424 and port 86, respectively, at B994 through B997. All four exact native-cone containment checks pass. The per-call profile changes by `-12 H1 + 28 H2 - 16 H3`; the local rank mass changes from 5586 to 5582 and the coverage identity recharges the difference to idle mass, 1646 to 1650. This is not free work.

The previous two-end recipe matches only ends 574/575, eight B frames and two early-cleanup frames. The four-end proposal changes 159 frame annotations; 149 changes (61 A, 86 B and 2 early-cleanup) are outside that recipe. Its owner schedule, source windows, copies, restorations, phase/wrapper admission and full outer invoice are absent, so this package does not establish caller admission or supplier realizability.

## Verification

- `python3 -B research/complex-four-end-caller-map/verify.py --write` — passed and refreshed `RESULT.json`.
- `python3 -B research/complex-four-end-caller-map/verify.py` — passed.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-four-end-caller-map --check-only` — package metadata and pins passed.
- Registered replay was not available: the package targets Python 3.12, while this host has Python 3.14.8 and no Python 3.12 runtime.

No new κ, complete multiplication theorem, supplier admission or selected-frontier update is claimed. Credit: PR #2013 and its frame-LP lineage; PRs #1030/#1090 and #1031 for the smaller two-end physical construction; predecessor/helper-inventory work in PR #3125 remains distinct because it screens per-call moments, not this exact four-end caller receipt.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-four-end-caller-map` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-four-end-caller-map --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
